issues: Says the function 'fits' a GARCH(1,1) model, but the record only filters with user-supplied or default alpha/beta and does not estimate parameters.

The record flags the default magnitudes as a limitation because BCBS d578 recalibrated them in 2024 (effective 2026). The answer reads as if the defaults already reflect d578, which inverts that caveat.
It promises six shock curves but describes only four (parallel up/down, steepener, flattener); the short-rate up/down shocks are not mentioned.
It says the short/long weights vary by tenor but omits the e^{-t/4} decay that defines how.
The last bullet sits under 'use this function when' but describes a need that the sibling unexpected_loss_ul_computation meets, not this function.
That framing implies EL gives the loss spread around the average, which the record does not support.
